question:
The given bar graph represents the sales of automobiles (in Rs. crores) by five companies A. B, C, D and E in the years 2007-2008 and 2008-2009.

Study the bar graph and answer the question that follows.

(*Note: The data shown below is only for mathematical exercise. It does not represent the actual figures of the companies*)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9116675258f188b4526ae6aff2531231bb417aaa166128de05ba1f8a8d0cc5c6.png] 

What should have been the sales (in Rs. crores) of company E in 2008-2009 so that it would have shown the same increase over 2007-2008 as shown by the sales of automobiles of company C during these years?
solution:
Calculation:

Sales increase for Company C = 1080 - 1000 = 80 Cr.

Sales for Company E should have been = 1440 + 80 = 1520 Cr.

**∴ 1520 Cr. should have been the sales (in Rs. crores) of company E in 2008-2009 so that it would have shown the same increase over 2007-2008 as shown by the sales of automobiles of company C during these years.**
